vMatrix.notes: Three independent sources agree on the summon trio (Robo Launcher RM7, Rock n Shock, Bots n Tots) and on the six skills that matter overall; they differ on how the damage-side three are grouped, see conflicts. Older lists that circulate under Korean skill names (Massive Fire, Support Waver H-EX, Magnetic Field, Robo Factory RM1) come from a 2021 page and predate HEXA. NO SOURCE FOUND states how node priority shifts between Lv 200 and Lv 260, or after 6th job. That is a real gap, not an omission.

hexa.notes: NO MECHANIC-SPECIFIC HEXA INVESTMENT ORDER WAS FOUND IN ANY DATED, VERIFIABLE SOURCE. Left empty deliberately rather than guessed. What was found instead: (1) Class-agnostic order from The Digital Crowns, updated 2025-01-31: activate the 6th job Mastery node first, then Boost nodes, then open HEXA Stat once a HEXA Stat activation costs less than the next skill level; activate everything before deep-levelling one node. That same page states per-class HEXA priority is not yet written and sends readers to class Discords. (2) Grandis Library's Mechanic page has no HEXA section and points to the Mechanic class Discord at https://discord.gg/JenpnsgHBc. (3) The Korean community wiki namu.wiki is indexed as giving a mastery-core order of Multiple Option: M-FL, then Micro Missile Container, then Metal Armor Full Salvo and Mecha Carrier together. Single source, Korean naming that does not map cleanly onto GMS skill names, undated, and the page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so it is recorded as unverified and NOT promoted into an order. (4) Orange Mushroom's Blog, 2026-07-11, reports a Mechanic HEXA skill core named Buster Station, an installed missile station, in KMST 1.2.203. KMST is the Korean test server; there is no evidence this is live in GMS v.271.

gearingNotes: DEX is the main stat and STR the secondary, so every stat roll, potential line and stat allocation follows the DEX-pirate pattern; the weapon is a Gun with a Magnum as the secondary weapon (Grandis Library, patch-stamped GMS Ver. 269). The one Mechanic-specific gearing lever found in sourced material is buff duration: the class Legion effect gives up to +25% buff duration and Grandis Library lists buff duration as a competitive inner-ability second line, which makes percent-buff-duration sources worth more on this character than on a class without that Legion effect. Nothing class-specific about armour set choice, arcane or genesis weapon path, familiar lines, or HEXA Stat lines was found in any source that could be dated, so those are left unwritten rather than guessed.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: Not fabrication, but unverifiable names promoted into prose: hexa.notes records a namu.wiki mastery-core order naming "Metal Armor Full Salvo", "Multiple Option: M-FL" and "Micro Missile Container". I re-fetched namu.wiki and got the same HTTP 403, so this is still unread. Grandis Library's full skill list for Mechanic contains no skill by any of those three names - the closest real 5th job skills are "Full Metal Barrage" and "Mecha Carrier". "Metal Armor Full Salvo" matches no GMS skill I could confirm anywhere. The file flags it as unverified, which is the right call, but a planner UI rendering hexa.notes would put three unconfirmed skill names in front of a user.

commonMistakes[0] attributes the Korean-named list (Massive Fire, Support Waver H-EX, Magnetic Field, Robo Factory: RM1) to the thedigitalcrowns 2021 page. That page's Mechanic entry is past the fetch truncation point on every attempt, so the attribution is unverified in both directions - I could not confirm the page carries those names, and the researcher's own notes give no sign they read past the truncation either.

STALE: The HEXA section's central negative is wrong. conflicts[4].positionB says "No GMS-facing source found names any Mechanic HEXA skill core; Grandis Library's Mechanic page carries no HEXA section at all." Grandis Library names three Mechanic 6th job skills: Ground Zero (360s cooldown, 10s duration, bind + iFrame), Robo Conversion: CB-P1 (toggle), and Mechanized Extinction. The orangemushroom article the file cites is titled "3rd Hexa Skill Core" - consistent with two already live - and the researcher never reconciled that. As written, the file tells a GMS v.271 Mechanic that no HEXA core has been named for their class, which is false.

STALE: vMatrix.notes states "NO SOURCE FOUND states how node priority shifts between Lv 200 and Lv 260, or after 6th job. That is a real gap, not an omission." The after-6th-job half is contradicted by the file's own top source. Grandis Library's Boost Node legend states that PRIMARY nodes "unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery and are skills that are frequently used" while SECONDARY nodes "don't unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery but are still used". That is exactly the 6th-job rationale for prioritising Node 1 (Salvo line) and Node 2 (Homing Beacon) over the summon trio, and it went unrecorded.

STALE: The staleness verdict in commonMistakes[0] rests on a mis-dated source. sources[] dates thedigitalcrowns/perfect-boost-nodes-for-every-class-maplestory-2021 as "2021 (per page title)" and vMatrix.notes says the Korean-named list "comes from a 2021 page and predate[s] HEXA". The page header states "Last Updated 03/31/2026". The researcher dated a source from its URL slug instead of its stated update date - the one mistake this brief most explicitly warns against - and then built a commonMistakes entry on it.

STALE: Recency rule is breached without disclosure. The brief requires sources dated after 2025-01-01. Not one Mechanic V matrix, hyper skill, hyper stat or inner ability claim in this file is supported by a post-2025 source: the support is 2024-11-21 (mystyjl), 2024-02-19 (DigitalTQ), 2020-12-23 (AyumiLove) and an undated page carrying a site-wide Ver. 269 footer. The only two post-2025 sources (thedigitalcrowns 2025-01-31, orangemushroom 2026-07-11) contribute nothing Mechanic-specific and nothing GMS-live respectively. hyperSkills.notes says "Only two sources here are current" - the honest statement is that zero sources in this file are both current and Mechanic-specific.
clearedOnInspection: No fabricated node names in the actionable arrays. I confirmed every name in vMatrix.priority, vMatrix.trios and hyperSkills against Grandis Library's live skill list: Heavy Salvo Plus, AP Salvo Plus, Homing Beacon, Distortion Bomb, Robo Launcher RM7, Rock 'n Shock, Bots 'n Tots, Support Unit: H-EX, Giant Robot SG-88, Full Spread, For Liberty all exist. Spirit of Freedom (max 12, 4 stacks), the +5/10/15/20/25% buff-duration Legion effect, DEX/STR, Gun/Magnum all check out verbatim. "Buster Station" is real: orangemushroom.net 2026-07-11 exists and describes an installed missile station firing 12 missiles up to 180. Cosmetic defect only: the file writes "Rock n Shock" and "Bots n Tots" without the apostrophes the game uses, which will break exact-name matching in a planner.

blockedReason: 6 claim(s) did not survive independent re-checking. See contest.defects. This file is research, not guidance, until they are resolved.
